hints: Every route in this directed acyclic graph has a unique next edge from its first city.
Process cities in reverse topological order so all successor route counts are already known.
Set ways[n]=1 and sum successor counts modulo 1,000,000,007.
analogy: Count routes backward: each outgoing flight offers all routes from its destination.
example: For 1->2->4 and 1->3->4, there are two routes from 1 to 4.
algorithm: Topologically sort; in reverse order set ways[u]=sum(ways[v]) over outgoing edges, with ways[n]=1.
correctness: Each route from u chooses exactly one first edge u->v and then a route from v; the DAG prevents cycles and duplicate counting.
